namespace PubAC24
structure LeaseState where
  epoch : Nat
  leader : Nat
def grantLease (s : LeaseState) (reqEpoch candidate : Nat) : Option LeaseState :=
  if reqEpoch > s.epoch then some ⟨reqEpoch, candidate⟩ else none
theorem lease_epoch_monotonic (s s' : LeaseState) (reqEpoch candidate : Nat) (h : grantLease s reqEpoch candidate = some s') : s'.epoch > s.epoch ∧ s'.leader = candidate := by sorry
theorem lease_reject_stale (s : LeaseState) (reqEpoch candidate : Nat) (hle : reqEpoch ≤ s.epoch) : grantLease s reqEpoch candidate = none := by sorry
end PubAC24
